steps.en: Install the framework and select a compatible Puppet provider
steps.zh: 安装 framework，并选择兼容的 Puppet provider

steps.en: Loads that Puppet behind the normalized messaging API
steps.zh: 把该 Puppet 接到归一化消息 API 后面

steps.en: Register handlers for scan, login, and incoming messages
steps.zh: 为扫码、登录与收到消息注册 handler

steps.en: Logs in through the provider and emits platform events as common objects
steps.zh: 经 provider 登录，把平台 event 发成通用 object

steps.en: Handle the message and send a reply through the same API
steps.zh: 处理消息，再通过同一 API 回复

value.en: Your bot logic stays above provider-specific IM protocols
value.zh: bot 逻辑不再直接绑定某一种 IM provider 协议
